title: 英作文の採点がゴミすぎる
body: 数回に一度、英作文の時間があるが、毎回採点が最悪すぎる。というのも、使っている単語、文法に間違いはないのに、解答と同じ文を作成しないと正解にならない。同じ意味の動詞でも、解答通りの単語を使わないと、間違いだと言われるのがものすごい癪に触る。もっと、採点に使っているAIの採点の幅を持たせ、臨機応変な採点ができるようにしてほしい。

title: タイトル：新しい単語テストの判定が理不尽すぎる
body:
今回のアップデートで追加された単語テストは、正直かなりひどいです。

英語から日本語に翻訳する問題で、意味が正しいにもかかわらず、不正解と判定されるケースが多すぎます。

例えば、「philosophy」は「哲学」では不正解で「てつがく」なら正解、「goal」は「目標」では不正解で「ゴール」しか認められません。

さらに、動詞の活用形にも一貫性がありません。「give up」は「諦める」では不正解で「諦めます」が正解なのに、「compete」は逆に「競争する」が正解で「競争します」は不正解になります。

問題文には活用形や表記方法の指定がなく、正しい同義語や漢字表記すら受け付けません。

これは語学力を試すテストではなく、開発者が登録した正解を当てるゲームです。

語学学習アプリとして、正しい日本語を不正解と判定するのは致命的だと思います。早急に判定ロジックを改善し、複数の正しい表現を受け付けるようにしてください。

title: So annoying that I’m having to pay for something so terrible.
body: OK, I have so many negative things to say that I’m sure that there’s not enough room here to say it all. First, in chat mode it always interrupts me and talks over me and when I’m in the middle of a sentence will cut me off and go on and on about something and when I’m trying to finish my sentence, it just will just keep going. It won’t stop talking, even though I am talking and even if I increase my volume, and even if I just keep talking, it still keeps talking! That is so infuriating! I really hate how it always says my name to me, when I know my own name! So many frustrating and annoying aspects to this app, and that I’m paying for it is the real kick in the pants.  It gives me incorrect information all the time, I literally spent an entire Sunday trying to build a pitch deck that it never got right, it was absolute torture! Try to make some garden plans for my backyard, and it never ever got any of it right. Plant lists, or images of imaginary plants, sure. But couldn’t actually plan out a real garden plan based on pictures from my actual yard. Doesn’t look up simple things that if I go to Google, I can find right away. I shouldn’t have to jump back-and-forth between different apps and Claude by the way, to get a straight answer. And that it will spend five questions not answering my question! Absolutely infuriating. If this was a real person, I would’ve already stopped being friends with them, if this was a boyfriend, I’d have dumped him a long time ago. He just doesn’t do what he’s supposed to do, and then he’s really rude about it sometimes too. Is frequently dismissive, frequently condescending, frequently in accurate, and there’s literally zero accountability for any of it. title: A Game-Changer for Independent Design, Engineering, and Software Development
body:
Claude Has Fundamentally Transformed My Design and Development Process

I operate CONCEPT2FORM, an independent industrial design, engineering, and development firm based in Traverse City, Michigan. My work spans multiple disciplines, including custom application development, advanced web architecture, user interface and experience design, workflow automation, AI integration, technical engineering, and physical product development. At the core of everything I do is a commitment to creating highly functional, intuitive, and exceptionally well-engineered solutions that seamlessly connect complex technology with real human needs.

Claude has fundamentally changed what I can accomplish as an independent designer and developer.

Ten years ago, developing applications with the level of sophistication, functionality, and refinement I’m now achieving would have required months, if not years, of programming, debugging, testing, and iterative development just to reach a viable beta release. Today, with Claude integrated into my development workflow, I can translate highly complex concepts into functional, polished applications in a fraction of that time.

What impresses me most isn’t simply the speed of development. It’s the quality of the architecture, the accuracy of the execution, and the remarkable level of functional integration Claude delivers. From sophisticated user interfaces and intuitive navigation systems to complex backend logic, interconnected application modules, and automated workflows, Claude consistently produces results that would have previously demanded extensive development resources.

In my experience, the accuracy of its initial execution is extraordinary. Code that might have required days of troubleshooting and rewriting is frequently delivered with an impressive degree of completeness on the first iteration. When refinements are necessary, they’re generally minor adjustments rather than fundamental architectural corrections. The reduction in development friction alone represents an enormous advancement in productivity and overall project quality.

But I believe the most significant impact goes far beyond writing code.

Claude is fundamentally redefining the role of the independent designer, developer, and systems architect.

It allows me to operate at the highest level of the development process, concentrating on product strategy, system architecture, human-centered design, functional relationships, user experience, and the coordination of complex technologies rather than becoming consumed by the mechanics of writing and debugging thousands of lines of code.

As someone whose professional background spans architecture, industrial design, engineering, fabrication, and software development, I’ve always approached projects as interconnected systems. Every component, interaction, and functional requirement must contribute to a cohesive whole. Claude allows me to apply that same multidisciplinary design philosophy to software development with a level of speed, precision, and execution that simply wasn’t practical for an independent firm a decade ago.

The result is a fundamental shift in where I can invest my time and expertise. Instead of spending months translating a vision into code, I can concentrate on making the vision better: refining the experience, strengthening the functionality, anticipating user needs, and developing sophisticated, production-quality solutions.

For CONCEPT2FORM, this represents something much more meaningful than accelerated programming. It expands the capabilities of an independent design practice, making it possible to develop integrated digital products and intelligent systems at a level of sophistication that once required substantially larger teams and resources.

Claude doesn’t replace the designer. It empowers the designer to operate at an entirely different level.

The creative direction, engineering judgment, systems thinking, and understanding of human behavior still come from the person behind the project. Claude removes an extraordinary amount of the technical friction between concept and execution, allowing those skills to be applied where they deliver the greatest value.

After years of working across the disciplines of design, engineering, and development, I see this as one of the most significant advancements in the creative and technical process I’ve experienced.

It’s not simply making development faster. It’s fundamentally expanding what’s possible.

title: 很有趣的软件，质感略显粗糙
body:
软件的想法很有趣，类似的软件还有谜底黑胶。
两个软件都是可以 Load 你的 Apple Music 曲库，单纯的一个播放器软件。
Deckman 利用展开 iPhone Duo 来模拟打开磁带机，想法非常有趣，但是专辑显示的画面有点粗糙，谜底黑胶界面更美。
希望开发者可以优化软件界面的设计，毕竟几十块就买了个美好的界面，还是希望它好看一点。
